resources.string: Total sebum in the coating: %1$s µg
Average surface density = sebum mass ÷ coated area. At fixed mass, doubling the area halves the average density. At fixed area, doubling the mass doubles the average density.

Sebocytes in sebaceous glands produce sebum, which typically reaches the skin surface through hair follicles. This model assumes a uniform coating on a patch of skin with no sebum lost. The mass and area are illustrative, not measurements. The model does not describe actual surface distribution or predict individual secretion rates.
